svg.title: Parallelotope: up to two to the K profiles from K generating directions
svg.desc: Simulated three-dimensional embedding of binary latent feature data. Eight point clouds sit at the vertices of a parallelotope, labeled 000 to 111. Three thick arrows from vertex 000 are the generating directions; every other vertex is a sum of them. Hidden edges are dashed.
svg.text: K = 20: up to 1,048,576 profiles, 21 anchors to find
